summary: Phase 149O.1F.1 -- HATP Production Trust-Store Path Hardening: narrow repair of the sole Blocking finding from 149O.1F (B-149O.1F-1). Reproduced the pre-repair exploit directly against the unmodified module (setting HOME relocated HATPTrustStore.production().root; a self-authored registry.json at the redirected path resolved through resolve_deployment_authorization() to a real DeploymentBinding). Root cause: the authoritative production trust-root location depended on the ordinary, agent-controllable $HOME process-environment variable via Path.home(). Evaluated three candidate fixes: (1) pwd.getpwuid(os.geteuid()).pw_dir -- rejected, because in the frozen two-principal Class-B topology the Agent OS principal's own effective UID resolves to the Agent's own home, which the agent owns and can write to (the 'agent-home trap'); (2) trusted discovery of the Human/Admin principal's identity then resolving that principal's home -- rejected as requiring a new trusted deployment-configuration mechanism, out of scope for a narrow repair; (3) a fixed, platform-level system path with no dependency on any process-user identity at all -- selected. Replaced _default_production_trust_root() with a hardcoded, platform-keyed constant (/Library/Application Support/PCAE/HATP/trust-store on macOS, /etc/pcae/hatp/trust-store on Linux; any other sys.platform value, or os.name != 'posix', raises HATPBootstrapUnsupportedPlatformError and fails closed -- no environment-derived fallback). The resolver reads no environment variable, CLI flag, constructor argument, current working directory, or repository state; enforced both behaviorally (spoof matrix) and via a source-level AST guard against reintroducing Path.home()/os.environ/getenv/expanduser/getpass into the resolver. Verified the flip: HOME (set/unset/empty/malformed), USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, and CWD -- individually and combined -- no longer redirect the resolved root; a fake registry planted under a HOME-redirected path, and separately under the agent's own real OS home (the historical vulnerable location), is never read by HATPTrustStore.production(). Preserved all Wave-1/2 invariants: same-user readiness never READY, same-ID-wrong-root rejection, duplicate/revoked-binding rejection, production-factory/test-injection boundary (production() still takes no arguments, creates/provisions nothing, and no src/pcae/** call site passes a caller-controlled root into HATPTrustStore). Updated the two historical 149O.1F exploit-detector tests in place (not deleted) to record the before/after flip explicitly, corrected a pre-existing mis-scoped 'git diff HEAD' phase-attribution check in that same suite to pin against 149O.1F's own commit range instead (it could never actually verify phase attribution as originally written), and widened the 149O.1E environment-override test to include HOME. New authoritative regression suite (tests/test_phase_149o_1f_1_hatp_production_trust_store_path_hardening.py): 30 passed. Combined 149O.1E+149O.1F+149O.1F.1: 103 passed. tests/test_phase_149o_1c_*: 95 passed (unchanged). tests/test_phase_149o_1d_*: 32 passed on a clean tree. RAE/Permission-Broker/agent subset: 4608 passed. Fast Green: 4431 passed, unchanged baseline. Full suite (-n auto): 27964 passed/88 failed/10 skipped on the uncommitted diff; triaged via a git-stash clean-tree comparison of the exact 88 node IDs to 75 pre-existing/unrelated failures (identical on the clean tree -- packaging/wheel-build tests plus one pre-existing byte-check failure), 11 pytest-xdist parallel-worker isolation flakes (pass serially under -n0, both before and after this repair), and 2 dirty-tree-only checks (a bare 'git diff HEAD' check and the strategic-lineage phase-pointer check) confirmed to pass again once PROJECT_STATUS.md was updated and this phase's diff was committed. Zero new failures attributable to the repair. Verdict: HATP TRUST-STORE PATH HARDENING IMPLEMENTED -- READY FOR INDEPENDENT RE-VERIFICATION. B-149O.1F-1 CLOSED. HATP production remains NOT READY (Waves 3-7 unimplemented; current same-user deployment still NOT READY regardless of this repair). B-149O-1 through B-149O-4 remain OPEN. See docs/PHASE_149O_1F_1_HATP_PRODUCTION_TRUST_STORE_PATH_HARDENING.md.
